title: Dr. Vincent Sam Jebadurai — Educator, Researcher, Academic Leader, Mentor, Minister
description: Dr. Vincent Sam Jebadurai — educator, researcher, academic leader, mentor and minister. Explore his research, innovation, publications, leadership and service.
eyebrow: Educator · Researcher · Academic Leader · Mentor · Minister
lede: Educator, researcher, academic leader, mentor and minister working across education, structural engineering, innovation, institutional development and service.

title: About Dr. Vincent Sam Jebadurai | Building Structures. Building People.
description: The journey of Dr. Vincent Sam Jebadurai from structural engineering and doctoral research into teaching, institutional leadership, mentorship and service.
lede: I trained as a structural engineer. What I have spent seventeen years actually building is a good deal less tangible than that.

title: Academia | Teaching and Research Supervision | Dr. Vincent Sam Jebadurai
description: Teaching, doctoral supervision, peer review and academic service by Dr. Vincent Sam Jebadurai at Karunya Institute of Technology and Sciences.
h1: The fundamentals do not go out of date.
lede: Structural analysis, strength of materials and mechanics of solids are what every later technology rests on. Seventeen years of teaching has not changed that.

title: Research | Seismic Strengthening, 3D Concrete Printing, Construction Technology
description: Explore Dr. Vincent Sam Jebadurai's research in structural engineering, seismic strengthening, 3D concrete printing, additive manufacturing and emerging construction technologies.
h1: From how structures fail to how construction itself can change.
lede: The work began with masonry walls failing inside concrete frames. It now runs through printable materials, reinforcement integration and the digital methods used to inspect what gets built.

title: Innovation and Patents | 3D Concrete Printing and Seismic Reinforcement
description: Granted and published intellectual property by Dr. Vincent Sam Jebadurai, including Indian Patent No. 389408 for GI netting at RCC beam-column joints and construction 3D-printing inventions.
h1: When research becomes something that can be built.
lede: A granted Indian patent, two published applications and a filed system, each arising from a problem met in the laboratory rather than from a search for something to patent.

title: Publications | Refereed Journal and Conference Record
description: The refereed publication record of Dr. Vincent Sam Jebadurai: 37 journal and proceedings papers in structural engineering, masonry, construction materials, additive manufacturing and applied machine learning.
h1: A publication record that shows a change of direction.
lede: Masonry and seismic behaviour early, printable materials and applied machine learning recently. The bibliography below is searchable and filterable by year and research area.

title: Research Projects | Funded and Proposed Work
description: Funded and proposed research projects led by Dr. Vincent Sam Jebadurai, including the KSRG-funded multi-arm 3D printing system with integrated reinforcement.
h1: In the laboratory and on the drawing board.
lede: Funded work currently in build, and proposals under consideration. Status is stated plainly for each.

title: Academic Leadership | IQAC Coordination and NAAC A++ Accreditation
description: Institutional quality assurance, NAAC accreditation, admissions and academic administration by Dr. Vincent Sam Jebadurai as IQAC Coordinator at Karunya Institute of Technology and Sciences.
h1: Quality assurance is slow, unglamorous and decisive.
lede: As IQAC Coordinator he contributed to institutional quality-assurance efforts culminating in NAAC A++ accreditation with a CGPA of 3.53.

title: Institution Relations | Connecting Schools and Higher Education
description: Institution Relations at Karunya Institute of Technology and Sciences: school engagement, academic outreach and partnerships, including the MINDSPARK: Flag Hunters hackathon.
h1: Connecting Institutions, Schools and Higher Education
lede: School engagement, academic outreach and institutional partnerships, focused on creating meaningful pathways between learners and higher education.

title: Speaking | Invited Talks, Webinars and Resource-Person Engagements
description: Invited talks, webinars and faculty development sessions by Dr. Vincent Sam Jebadurai on concrete, construction technology and structural engineering.
h1: Technical subjects, explained for the people who have to use them.
lede: Webinars for practising engineers, faculty development for teachers, and technical sessions for students. Each engagement is listed with its actual format.

title: Ministry | Faith. Purpose. Service.
description: Ministry and biblical teaching by Dr. Vincent Sam Jebadurai, and how service has shaped his understanding of leadership and of academic work.
lede: My work in ministry has deepened my understanding of leadership as service. Knowledge can develop the mind; service is what reaches people and communities.

title: Service and Community Engagement
description: Institutional service, school outreach and community engagement by Dr. Vincent Sam Jebadurai alongside his teaching and research work.
h1: Service is visible in the work itself.
lede: Committee work, admissions, school outreach and institutional development — the parts of an academic career that rarely appear in a citation count.
